claim: Scheduled admission with bounded organic debt: per-hour organic admissions, claimed review executions, scheduled admissions and sheds, rolling execution totals, organic overload, and throttle pause for origin/main versus this branch.
head: 3febf5e6628f5be132e3d13cc0d35d36d9123d2f
runtime: workerd / SQLite Durable Object / native loopback GitHub fixture / fake clock

model.organic_new: new-item webhook enqueues (issues/opened), seeded Poisson arrivals; always a new key
model.organic_supersede: issues/edited with supersedesInProgress for a random dispatching or leased organic item (production_2026_10_01: dispatching only, before its run claims); revokes the owner
model.organic_requeue: an organic completion reports requeue_latest with the scenario's probability, as source-drift completions do
model.organic_closed_before_dispatch: production_2026_10_01 only: a seeded share of new organic items reads closed at the queue's dispatch-time live check and is completed without a run
model.execution: a successful /claim of a dispatched review lease (one workflow run attempt)
model.offers: each offer follows scheduled-review-enqueue: fresh candidates until the first shed; direct planners +3 min, fanout planners +6 min after cron
model.alarms: delivered at the queue's own requested wake time (min 1 s apart); stats sampled each simulated minute
model.admission: organic new key admitted, supersede admitted, requeue_latest completion requeued, or scheduled item admitted

limits: Synthetic GitHub fixture, RSA credential, organic arrival process and mix, closed-before-dispatch share, planner latency and review durations. Real queue admission, token buckets, supersession, requeue, dispatch-time live checks, dispatch, claim, completion, reconciliation, throttle feedback, alarms and SQLite storage. An execution is a successful claim; a run that claims and then exits early is still counted. No live inference, production state or GitHub mutations. clawhub/other-target supply, stale-head pull request deletes and GitHub Actions scheduling jitter are not modeled. Candidate supply is unlimited, the pessimistic case for the budget and for normal-backfill share.
